articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Video, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can simultaneously process and cross-reference video streams, audio, codebases, and documents in a single context window. Benchmarks show a 40% improvement in complex multi-step reasoning tasks over GPT-5's initial release. The model also introduces persistent memory across sessions, enabling long-running agentic workflows without context degradation.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on ARC-AGI-2 Benchmark
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 has scored 82% on the ARC-AGI-2 benchmark, a significant leap in abstract reasoning capability that approaches human-level performance on novel pattern recognition tasks. The achievement relies on a new architecture combining chain-of-thought search with learned program synthesis. Researchers caution that the benchmark, while indicative, does not equate to general intelligence.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Pilot Deployment in Amazon Fulfillment Centers
articles.summary: Tesla's third-generation Optimus humanoid robot has started a pilot program in select Amazon warehouses, handling bin-picking, shelf stocking, and package sorting tasks alongside human workers. The Gen 3 model features improved dexterous manipulation with 22 degrees of freedom per hand and on-device vision-language models for real-time task adaptation. Amazon reports a 15% throughput increase in pilot zones, though union representatives have raised workforce displacement concerns.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C as Its Humanoid Robot Demonstrates Autonomous Construction Tasks
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round at a $15 billion valuation after demonstrating its Figure 03 robot autonomously performing framing and drywall installation on a real construction site. The robot leverages a foundation world model trained on millions of hours of construction video and sim-to-real transfer. The funding will accelerate manufacturing scale-up with a target of 1,000 units deployed by mid-2027.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional Classifiers 2.0 to Combat Jailbreaks in Enterprise AI Deployments
articles.summary: Anthropic released Constitutional Classifiers 2.0, a layered safety system that reduces successful jailbreak rates to below 0.3% on adversarial benchmarks while maintaining task performance within 2% of unconstrained baselines. The system uses a lightweight interpretable classifier chain trained via constitutional AI principles, allowing enterprise customers to audit and customize safety boundaries. The release comes amid increasing regulatory pressure in the EU and US for demonstrable AI safety guarantees.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Process Node
articles.summary: TSMC has commenced high-volume manufacturing on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node using gate-all-around nanosheet transistors, promising a 25% performance gain and 35% power reduction over its N2 node. First customers include Apple and NVIDIA, with chips expected in consumer devices by Q2 2027. The node is critical for next-generation AI accelerators that demand higher transistor density to keep pace with rapidly scaling model parameters.

articles.title: Breakthrough Solid-State Battery from QuantumScape Achieves 600 Wh/kg in Automotive-Grade Cells
articles.summary: QuantumScape announced that its latest solid-state lithium-metal cells have reached 600 Wh/kg energy density at the cell level while passing automotive-grade cycle life testing of over 1,000 charge-discharge cycles with less than 10% degradation. This roughly doubles the energy density of current lithium-ion pouch cells used in EVs. Volkswagen confirmed plans to integrate the cells into a production vehicle platform starting in late 2027.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Behemoth with 2 Trillion Parameters Under Permissive License
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 Behemoth, a 2-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model, under its permissive Llama Community License, making it the largest openly available language model to date. The model matches or exceeds GPT-5 on several reasoning and code-generation benchmarks while being deployable across distributed GPU clusters using Meta's new FSDP2 sharding framework. The release intensifies the open-weight vs. closed-model debate and gives enterprise teams a powerful self-hostable alternative to API-only services.
